description:
How do you go from working as a local barista slicing cucumbers for crepes to running a massively popular financial food brand as the internet's undisputed cucumber king?

Welcome to the Forbes Top Creator Show! This week, host Steven Bertoni decodes the business of influence with food creator, communications specialist, and entrepreneur Logan Moffitt.

In this episode, Logan opens up about the powerful transition from his grueling 12-year competitive swimming background to social media stardom, proving how the discipline, endurance, and routine of the pool perfectly prepared him for the creator grind. He details his early days at U Ottawa studying communications while balancing two jobs, and how he spent almost two years posting four videos a day on TikTok before finally finding his audience.
